edges: Grameen Bank pioneered the concept of microcredit.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Most of Grameen Bank's borrowers use the small loans to start businesses.
The borrowers must form five-member groups that, along with the bank's field workers, closely supervise the loans.
The first two borrowers must start repaying the principal plus interest over a six-week period.
